map.因为 .properties 传统上按 ISO-8859-1 读取，非 Lati: Because .properties is traditionally read as ISO-8859-1, so any character outside Latin-1 must be escaped as \uXXXX. Java 9 changed the default to UTF-8, but many tools and older versions still follow the old rule. If you would rather not escape, use UTF-8 consistently and make sure the reading side is configured the same way; when exchanging between systems, keeping the escaped form is safest.
